en: Hang on a little longer, would you?
I'm getting the place ready right now.
Wait right there, would you?
It's still too early to open.
Just wait a bit longer.
Not often a customer turns up this early.
Hey there,
I'll be opening up soon, so
hang on a bit, okay?
Maybe I should just open earlier, then.
This is the Kaiser pub.
Don't think I've seen your face before, sir.
Welcome! Sorry to keep you waiting.
Go on, order all you like.
You look like you can hold your drink, sir.
Our drinks run strong, but I'd say you
can drink as much as you like.
Come again.
Are you a military man, sir?
No, I'm not. Do I look like one?
No, you don't.
It's just that most customers here are
navy men. I thought maybe you were
one too.
Mind you, as long as you're a customer,
anybody's fine by me.
By the way,
have you heard this rumor?
Lots of warehouses around here, right?
Word is, lately some thief's been after
the cargo in those warehouses.
A thief
A lot of the cargo that ends up there
is rare stuff. Maybe that's why.
The other day I told you about the thief,
but have you heard this rumor?
There's one warehouse down at the harbor
that's not used anymore, but...
Word is, something shows up there.
A ghost
note: 'A ghost' + #2 '...' + #25 '.' prints 'A ghost....'; needs #25 variant '' for msg 119787.

en: A ghost
How absurd.
note: speaker-less line after the player's 'A ghost...?'; read as the player.

en: Ha ha. I figured you'd say that, sir.
Thanks for always being a regular.
Hope to keep seeing you around!
Whoa
Wh-who's there? At this hour?
S-sir, you can't do this! At this hour,
coming all the way back here
W-wait, are you
that thief the whole harbor's talking about?
I'm afraid not.
I'm nearer to the other rumor
The other one
Gh-ghost?
note: leading space so it reads 'The other one... Gh-ghost?' after #2.

en: Aaaaagh!
To a human, vampires and ghosts are
much the same, I suppose.
Both wander, unable to die.
Hang on a little longer, would you?
Just wait a bit longer.
Oh? Haven't seen your face before, sir.
We've got plenty of strong stuff, so
don't go keeling over on me.
Thinking of joining the military, sir?
The military... I've never considered it.
Didn't think so. Say, what fine family
are you the young master of, anyway?
A ghost...
Oh? I'd like to meet it someday,
this so-called ghost.
D-don't be ridiculous!
I don't want anything to do with some
weird thing like that, not me.
A strange customer like you, young sir,
is one I've got to look after.
How may I help you?
Is something ailing you?
I'm Schneider, the doctor.
My consultation hours begin shortly.
